mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (primaquine by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; terbinafine is a CYP2D6 inhibitor), and terbinafine may increase primaquine levels, elevating risk of hemolytic toxicity in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia symptoms; consider baseline G6PD testing; use lowest primaquine dose with careful clinical monitoring if combination is necessary.
